downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.57.0，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.57.0. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 盲测存档：新建训练时打开「盲测」，点创建时才随机抽开始时间；训练中图表和列表只显示星期和时刻，练完再揭晓日期。
highlights.en: Blind sessions: turn on Blind test when creating a session and the start is drawn at random; while you train, the chart and lists show only the weekday and time until you reveal the dates.

highlights.zh: AI 导师读盘：按当前回放时刻解读行情，给出倾向、多空两种情形和带仓位的计划；策略里的 AI 系统助手可以生成或修改完整的交易系统。
highlights.en: Mentor market read: reads the market at the replay moment with a lean, both cases and a sized plan; the AI system assistant in Strategies drafts or edits a complete trading system.

highlights.zh: 外盘下载新增美元指数 DXY、US2000、富时中国 A50、VOLIDX 及 USDCNH 等 9 个品种；持仓列表的表头可拖动排序，右键选择显示哪些列。
highlights.en: Nine new global instruments, including the dollar index DXY, US2000, FTSE China A50, VOLIDX and USDCNH; drag position-table headers to reorder them and right-click to choose columns.

highlights.zh: 下载按整次任务申请授权，限流时有限次重试；订单改用存档内的短编号，部分平仓按 MT4 方式衔接并显示前后关联；新增 Alt＋左键任意价差测量。
highlights.en: Downloads are authorized once per task and retry rate limits a bounded number of times; orders get short numbers within each session, and partial closes link their remainders as MT4 does; Alt-click measures any price distance.

highlights.zh: 修复 Windows 关机后资料库打不开、日志和交易笔记里粘贴的截图丢失、统计把分批平仓当成加仓等问题。
highlights.en: Fixed a library that would not open after a Windows shutdown, screenshots pasted into journal and trade notes going missing, and partial closes being counted as adding to a position.
